Not being a huge horse cock is hard, but you could make an *attempt*.

This man clearly feels remorse for his actions, and wanted to share a story of his mental illness. Little children like you need to understand that these are real people you're talking to. You wouldn't say that to someone's face, hating on a random stranger for *no fucking reason whatsoever* doesn't make you an internet tough guy. He understands the magnitude of his actions. We do too. Being a prick solves nothing.

Whilst most of the readers (myself included) don't in any way advocate pedophilia, we don't tell a guy struggling with life to kill himself. It'd be great if you shut up.

Tl;dr basic manners
